name: targets
label: Targets
help: Where the post goes: one item per platform set. Each platform needs an active account in that set. Most users have one set and add one item.

spec.name: platformSetId
spec.label: Platform set
spec.help: Leave empty for your default platform set.

name: text
label: Text
help: The post text. Each platform's length limit applies; **Validate a post** checks it.

name: linkUrl
label: Link URL
help: A link to attach. Platforms that take no link card ignore it.

name: media
label: Media
help: Images and videos at public https URLs, in order. To post a file from your scenario, upload it with **Upload a media file** first and map its URL here.

spec.name: altText
spec.label: Alt text
spec.help: Image description for screen readers, on platforms that take it.

name: when
label: When to publish
help: **Next free queue slot** needs exactly one target and a queue set up for its platform set in Ampost.

name: youtube
label: YouTube options
help: Used when a target includes YouTube. **Made for kids** is required for YouTube.

spec.name: title
spec.label: Title
spec.help: Up to 100 characters, no `<` or `>`. Default: the first line of the text.

spec.name: madeForKids
spec.label: Made for kids
spec.help: YouTube's COPPA setting. Required for YouTube.

spec.name: playlistId
spec.label: Playlist ID
spec.help: Adds the video to this playlist of the channel.

spec.name: categoryId
spec.label: Category ID
spec.help: For example `22` (People & Blogs, the default) or `28` (Science & Technology).

name: tiktok
label: TikTok options
help: Used when a target includes TikTok. **Privacy** and **Consent** are required unless you send it as an inbox draft.

spec.name: privacyLevel
spec.label: Privacy
spec.help: Pick one of the account's allowed levels (List accounts: Platform metadata).

spec.name: consent
spec.label: Consent
spec.help: Yes only after the user agreed to TikTok's Music Usage Confirmation.

spec.name: inboxDraft
spec.label: Send as an inbox draft
spec.help: The creator finishes the post in the TikTok app.

name: pinterest
label: Pinterest options
help: Used when a target includes Pinterest.

name: instagram
label: Instagram options
help: Used when a target includes Instagram.

spec.name: placement
spec.label: Placement
spec.help: Default: from the media (one image: feed, several: carousel, a video: reel).

name: facebook
label: Facebook options
help: Used when a target includes Facebook.

name: linkedin
label: LinkedIn options
help: Used when a target includes LinkedIn.

name: firstComment
label: First comment
help: A comment Ampost posts right after the post (on X, Threads and Bluesky a reply). Every target platform must support it.

name: thread
label: Thread
help: Follow-up posts, each a reply to the one before (X, Bluesky, Threads).

options.label: Pad to the platform's aspect ratio (default)
Crop to the platform's aspect ratio
None: reject media with the wrong aspect ratio

name: options
label: Other platform options (JSON)
help: Options the fields above do not cover, as a JSON object keyed by platform, for example `{"youtube": {"title": "My video", "privacyStatus": "public"}, "telegram": {"disableNotification": true}}`. A platform's fields above replace its key here. The options are listed at https://ampost.io/docs.

name: metadata
label: Metadata
help: Your own key-value pairs (at most 4 KB), such as an ID from your sheet. Returned on the post and in webhook events.

name: Idempotency-Key
label: Idempotency key
help: Optional. 1-255 visible ASCII characters, for example a UUID or the ID of the item this post comes from. If Make runs the module again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours, Ampost returns the first result instead of creating a second post.
